name: Gibbon
tagline: the swinger: tether, reel, fling (merged with the Tether prototype)
summary: The swinger, merged with the Tether prototype (cece/loving-feynman-hlgf18). Hold RT and a tether shoots to the best prism in reach: you pendulum round it on a rigid rope, reel in with LT to trade rope for speed, and let go to fling out on the tangent; a release past a half turn pays a boost. In Unity the same vessel also plants its own anchor prisms ahead and yanks itself along them hand over hand, and every tether is a light sword that cuts hostile prisms. Those two halves join the studio in its round-2 session; the numbers here are TetherConfig.asset's.

spec.v: RT tether · LT reel · release to fling
93 u (TetherConfig range), 60° cone, target memory 0.5 s
+20% past a half turn (releaseBoost), cap 358 u/s
grapple / web-swing: Spider-Man 2, Marvel Rivals, Echo Point Nova; the Tether prototype in Unity

fantasy: A brachiator in space. It never flies straight for long: it hooks the world and swings through it, and the mass other pilots lay is its forest canopy.
why: Grapple and swing is the second hottest movement verb of 2024-26 (Spider-Man 2 at 11M+, Marvel Rivals' most-loved heroes are its swingers, Echo Point Nova 98% positive). The forgiveness rules come from Echo Point Nova: a target is remembered for half a second after you looked past it, and the rope lets go on its own when it stops making sense.

charge.name: Fling
charge.tip: Charge is the energy of the fling: the release kick grows with it.

mass.name: Heft
mass.tip: Mass lets the rope reel shorter, so a heavy Gibbon whips round tighter. At level 5 the anchor prism becomes yours when you let go.

space.name: Long Arm
space.tip: Space is how far the tether reaches.

time.name: Quick Reel
time.tip: Time is how fast LT reels the rope in.

styles.name: Balanced
styles.info: Every element at 0: the recipe's numbers.

styles.name: Acrobat
styles.info: Long reach and a fast reel: chains swings far apart.

styles.name: Slinger
styles.info: Tight ropes and a big kick: fewer swings, each one a cannon shot.

styles.name: Maxed
styles.info: Every element at 10. A ceiling, not a match state.

notModelled: The rope is a point constraint with no gravity, reeled by LT; the Tether's SPIN LIMIT (0.6 rev/s), its AUTO-ANCHORS (own prisms planted 0.8 s ahead, alternating every 0.35 s) and its LIGHT SWORD (cutting hostile prisms) are built in Unity on cece/loving-feynman-hlgf18 and join this kind in the Gibbon's round-2 session (CONCEPT_FLEET.md section 8.1).
Aiming is a 60-degree cone ahead; the Tether aims with a search plane that roll tilts, and hooks per trigger side.
What a tether does to a rival's prism on contact: here only Harvest (Mass 5) converts the anchor; in Unity the beam cuts it.
sources: Design: Docs/Studios/CONCEPT_FLEET.md (Gibbon, and section 8.1 for the merge). Unity side: Assets/_Scripts/Controller/Vessel/R_VesselActions/TETHER.md and TetherConfig.asset on cece/loving-feynman-hlgf18 (reach 93, minHook 27, reelRate 40 + autoReel 7.4, minLength 19, maxSpin 0.6, maxSpeed 358, releaseBoost 0.2). Nearest shipped relative: the Thresher's chain and plant (THRESHER.md).
